A weekend away for **two**, first weekend of May.

Every branch below is one node with a description — the kind of half-plan that otherwise ends up scattered across five different notes.

The train wins: city centre to city centre, no airport transfer.

Tickets open **90 days** ahead and the cheap fare sells out first.

![Train ticket — Central to Old town, one way, €29](data/train-ticket.png)
Anywhere inside the tram ring works — the place is small enough to walk.
Everything within reach, but noisy on Saturday night.
Quieter, full of cafés, ten minutes by tram.

> Go before 7 a.m. — by nine it is shoulder to shoulder.

The light from the _east_ end is the good one.
Two rules: eat where the menu is not translated into five languages, and always ask before they pour the water.
Best view in town, plastic cups, cash only.

1. Book the train
2. Download an offline map
3. Get some cash — many places take **no cards**
4. Check the forecast (below)
